_comment: Species-locked items -> list of allowed species stems (data/mons/<stem>.json). Keys are normalized item ids (lowercased, separators removed). Read by tools/lint_team.py. A holder/item mismatch listed here is a HARD FAIL; an item NOT in this map is a WARN (never a silent pass), so new Z-crystals/stones surface for review. Generic type Z-crystals (Electrium Z, Waterium Z, Flyinium Z, etc.) are intentionally OMITTED because they are not species-locked. Eviolite is intentionally omitted (it ends in -ite but is not a mega stone).
